gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically confirmed recurrent supratentorial glioblastoma (WHO grade 4) (high grade glioma with molecular features of glioblastoma will be eligible).

candidate_evidence.quote: Lerapolturev (intratumoral) will be dosed at 2x108 TCID50 in 3.0 mL x 2 doses (total dose 4x108 TCID50) by Convection Enhanced Delivery.
subjects will be randomly assigned to receive either the FDA-approved chemotherapy (lomustine) or the study drug (lerapolturev).

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Proportion of patients who experience an unacceptable toxicity - Stage 2

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess treatment response and/or immunologic responses in the brain, a tissue biopsy of the area infused will be recommended 5 weeks (± 1 week) after the 2nd lerapolturev infusion via CED

role_evidence.quote: This will be followed by subcutaneous injections of lerapolturev in the cervical perilymphatic (CPL) area on the same side as their tumor

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant oncolytic poliovirus (PVSRIPO), intratumoral CED and cervical perilymphatic injection

role_evidence.quote: Following maximal safe resection of their tumor recurrence subjects will receive Lomustine as a single oral dose of 110 mg/m2 every six weeks for up to 9 cycles.

coder_notes: Lerapolturev (PVSRIPO) is a recombinant oncolytic poliovirus, so the only investigational agent is an excluded intervention type; lomustine is the comparator-only arm. Poliovirus vaccine booster (IPOL) is a pre-treatment inclusion requirement, not a registered intervention, so not listed. MGMT appears only in an exclusion criterion about prior chemotherapy, not as an entry biomarker.
